newsitem.title: USA: Dow jumps 77 points, pacing strong large-cap rally.
newsitem.headline: Dow jumps 77 points, pacing strong large-cap rally.

text.p: Wall Street stocks powered higher on Monday, as a ferocious run by a handful of blue chips helped spark a strong rally in large-cap stocks.

The Dow industrials jumped 77 points to close unofficially at 7008. The index's gain was led by International Business Machines Corp, which surged 6-1/4 points to 143-7/8, and Philip Morris Cos Inc, up 6-1/8 to 135-1/4.
"The nod keeps going to the big-cap, blue chip stocks," said Alan Ackerman, market strategist at Fahnestock & Co.
